item.text: {"search_note":"I found no credible 2024 evidence of Sisi voluntarily preparing a handoff to a successor, honoring a meaningful coalition constraint, or accepting a genuine constitutional transfer of power beyond the formal swearing-in ceremony. The positive evidence is procedural only: a constitutional oath, parliamentary ceremony, and cabinet reshuffle. The substantive record is continued incumbency, opposition suppression, and elite recycling within the same security state.","evidence":[{"title":"Formal oath-taking before parliament for a new six-year term","publisher":"State Information Service","date":"2024-04-02","url":"https://sis.gov.eg/en/media-center/news/president-el-sisi-takes-the-constitutional-oath-for-new-presidential-term/","summary":"Sisi was sworn in before the House of Representatives under Article 144, which is procedural evidence of a constitutional inauguration. This supports only a narrow, formal-positive reading of transfer-of-power compliance.","question_ids":["4B.8"]},{"title":"Presidency framed the oath as constitutional continuity, not a handoff to a successor","publisher":"Presidency of the Republic of Egypt","date":"2024-04-02","url":"https://www.presidency.eg/en/%D9%82%D8%B3%D9%85_%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D8%AE%D8%A8%D8%A7%D8%B1/%D8%A3%D8%AE%D8%A8%D8%A7%D8%B1-%D8%B1%D8%A6%D8%A7%D8%B3%D9%8A%D8%A9/event242024/","summary":"The presidency described the event as the start of a new presidential term and repeated Sisi’s pledge to uphold the constitution. This shows formal procedure, but not respect for succession rules or term-limit restraint.","question_ids":["4B.8"]},{"title":"Freedom House says Sisi secured a third term in a noncompetitive election after term-length changes","publisher":"Freedom House","date":"2024","url":"https://freedomhouse.org/country/egypt/freedom-world/2024","summary":"Freedom House states that 2019 amendments extended Sisi’s current term through 2024 and that he then secured a third six-year term in an election with arrests and intimidation. That is strong evidence against genuine respect for term limits.","question_ids":["4B.8","4B.1","4B.2"]},{"title":"HRW says authorities jailed and banned Tantawy for challenging Sisi","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024-06-04","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/06/04/egypt-opposition-leader-imprisoned","summary":"HRW says Ahmed Tantawy and supporters were imprisoned and barred from future elections after a peaceful challenge to Sisi. This cuts against any claim that succession or transfer rules were meaningfully open to contestation.","question_ids":["4B.8","4B.1","4B.2","4B.5"]},{"title":"Reuters reported Sisi moved defense leaders into presidential adviser roles in a July reshuffle","publisher":"Reuters via Yahoo","date":"2024-07-03","url":"https://www.yahoo.com/news/egypts-sisi-names-ex-defence-140545714.html","summary":"The defense minister and chief of staff were replaced, but both outgoing officials were retained as presidential advisers. That suggests managed elite rotation inside the same security network, not a real succession transition.","question_ids":["4B.8","4B.5"]},{"title":"Reuters reported the intelligence chief was replaced by his deputy and then kept close as an adviser","publisher":"Reuters via MarketScreener","date":"2024-10-16","url":"https://www.marketscreener.com/news/latest/Egypt-s-Sisi-replaces-head-of-powerful-general-intelligence-agency-48090165/","summary":"The outgoing intelligence chief became an adviser to the presidency, and Reuters noted the agency’s domestic-security role under Sisi. This looks like continuity and consolidation, not preparation for institutionalized succession.","question_ids":["4B.8","4B.5"]},{"title":"Sisi’s July cabinet message emphasized institutional coordination, not transfer of power","publisher":"State Information Service","date":"2024-07-03","url":"https://sis.gov.eg/en/media-center/news/president-el-sisi-meets-prime-minister-and-members-of-the-new-government/","summary":"Sisi told the new government to strengthen institutional frameworks, coordination, integrity, and transparency. That is a governance signal, but it does not evidence any real acceptance of succession limits or coalition transfer.","question_ids":["4B.8","4B.4"]}]}
